architecture_diagnosis.conclusion: Two independent architecture breaks: compositional description matching and entity-start copy alignment.  Fixing one alone leaves the other as the binding ceiling; no single small change clears the task.

candidate_17_admission.least_change_rule: The least-change rule prefers the smallest change that clears the gate.  Here no single small change clears both independent breakpoints, so the minimal sufficient set is multi-part.  Candidate 17 contains that set plus a diagnostic third arm; it is the higher-ceiling primary.  Its cost is the binding risk, not its design: if the owner fixes the budget, a two-arm A/B version of the same design is the smaller variant (drop C), not a substitute for the design.
